title: spec(forms): the Permission Set, Position and view form help texts an admin reads in Setup carry ADR numbers (permission.form.ts, position.form.ts, view.form.ts); the spec half of #23829
body:
Filing gate ④: the `packages/spec` half of #23829, cut by triage. It is the same family as #23808 (the metadata type descriptions, landed). `packages/spec` is the spec seat's whatever needs it, so these lines cannot ride #23829's `domain:services` PR. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat.

## What an admin reads

Measured by the #23802 dev at `1ecb08a1c` (#23829's addendum `6211169527`). Served through `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` on Setup's Permission Sets and Positions edit forms:

- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts`: the `isDefault`, `managedBy`, `packageId` and `adminScope` help texts carry "ADR-0090 D5", "ADR-0086 D3" and "ADR-0090 D12".
- `packages/spec/src/identity/position.form.ts` (~:39): the `delegatable` help text carries "ADR-0091 D3".
- `view.form.ts`: the item #23829 lists.

## The change

- Rewrite each user-facing help string in an admin's words, as #23808 did.
- ADR references stay in docblocks and comments.
- This is spec 辅助面 only: a `patch` changeset, and no accept or refuse result changes. Not the protocol-first class.

## Acceptance

- None of these help strings contains `ADR-`, `D\d`, `finding F`, `emit()` or `kernel`.
- `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` and the locale files regenerate. Whichever of this card and #23829 lands second regenerates them.

## Grade

**p2**, the family's grade.

## Dedupe

The parent is #23829. The family is #23802 and #23808 (closed).
